description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is a critical leadership opportunity for an RN passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment. We are looking to fill this role by June 30th, so prompt application is encouraged.

As the DON, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of clinical excellence and regulatory compliance. You will be responsible for managing nursing staff, developing care plans, and implementing best practices to enhance resident outcomes and satisfaction. This position offers a competitive salary and the chance to make a significant impact within a dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or in a similar nursing leadership role
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and manage a diverse nursing team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Unit Manager, Wound Care Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Frostburg, MD. This vital role involves overseeing unit operations and providing specialized wound care, ensuring the highest standards of patient care and clinical excellence.As a Unit Manager, Wound Care Nurse, you will leverage your expertise to manage patient care plans, lead a team of compassionate healthcare professionals, and deliver expert wound management. This full-time opportunity offers a competitive hourly rate of $35.00 - $40.00, reflecting your valuable skills and commitment.If you are an RN with a passion for leadership and wound care, and are looking for a rewarding role in a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply. Join a team dedicated to making a significant difference in the lives of our residents.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Maryland.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in wound care.
Prior experience in a supervisory or leadership capacity within a healthcare setting.
Demonstrated ability to manage a unit and provide comprehensive patient care.
Excellent communication, organizational, and clinical assessment skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $35.00 - $40.00, based on experience and qualifications.
